[26.1 版本移植資訊](https://wiki.chaotictrials.de/porting/version/26.1/) **[![#StandWithUkraine](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vshymanskyy/StandWithUkraine/main/banner2-direct.svg)](https://vshymanskyy.github.io/StandWithUkraine)** ![標頭](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/aiot-botania/header.png)
![總覽](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/aiot-botania/overview.png)
![創造模式標籤頁](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/aiot-botania/creative_tab.png) 元素鍬／AIOT 不僅能製作耕地，還能生成 *超級耕地*。它不需要水源，且從高處掉落時也不會變回泥土。再加上那粉紅色的閃光特效，*太讚了*！更多各項工具的詳細資訊請參閱 **Lexica Botania**。 ![超級耕地預覽](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/aiot-botania/super_farmland_preview.gif)
![合成表](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/aiot-botania/recipes.png)
點擊展開 **元素 AIOT** ![元素 AIOT 合成表](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/aiot-botania/recipes/elementium_aiot.png) **活石剪刀** ![活石剪刀合成表](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/aiot-botania/recipes/livingrock_shears.png) **活木剪刀** ![活木剪刀合成表](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/aiot-botania/recipes/livingwood_shears.png)
歡迎將此模組加入任何您喜歡的整合包中。 ![[廣告](https://www.bisecthosting.com/melanx)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/aiot-botania/promo.png) #廣告 #Ad
